prose.text: The standard gate set runs in the test-plan §3 order. `capability-drift` precedes the default-features workspace nextest. The `--features mcp-server` bindings regen and the base-identity bindings close come last, since no procedure is added. The chunk's own entries come first: - the probe build, the collection proofs and the targeted runs over the new pins; - the dry-run composition over every arm; - the scope guard and the log-target census; - the English-sources gate.

Absences, each with its reason: - No `pulse-app/ui/**` path is touched, so the webview gates are absent. - No package is added or upgraded, and `Cargo.lock` is guarded unchanged by the scope guard. So `cargo deny` /   `cargo audit` are not listed locally; CI's `supply-chain` job runs them, and the operator CI read asserts it green. - **No boot smoke.** None of the touched files is a test-plan §3 boot-smoke trigger path (`main.rs`, `ui-bridge/src/`,   `observability.rs`, `tauri.conf.json`, `capabilities/`). The probe drives the production argv builder, guard,   timeout and extractor by construction (`l4_decision_probe.rs:81-85`, `:747`). The product's `model_identity` value   follows the file stem with no code change (`llamacli_inference.rs:254-257`). - There is no harness live leg and no self-verify; this is not a UI chunk.

**The real-model legs** are `leg = 'operator'` entries. They hold the model slot and the GPU, which the overseer granted for this chunk with conductor-builder idle (inputs#I1). /implement fires each once, in daytime only, and the wrap's light gate never re-runs them. Their readings are re-verified from `evidence/`. Each one: - is preceded by a `build` of the example, built outside the timed run (verification-harness.md 2026-08-23); - takes the prior series' firing form (research §Conventions to follow): unset the three overrides, source   `l4-env.sh` (inputs#I4), then set `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_MODEL_PATH` per model in the loop.

The CPU-only leg adds `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_HARDWARE_PROFILE=cpu_primary` and an empty `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`. The CUDA build at `-ngl 0` still offloads the KV cache and large-batch ops to the GPU by default (`common.h:553,556`), so without hiding the device the "CPU-only" read would be GPU-assisted. A loop runs every model even after one fails a gate, so the table is whole. An INCONCLUSIVE probe (exit 2) stops its loop.

`cargo xtask pre-push:linux` cannot evaluate on this Linux host (`wsl.exe`, `xtask/src/pre_push.rs`). As in the predecessor chunks (founder deviation 2026-10-04), its six stages run NATIVELY by hand before the push, as the six `operator` entries after hygiene. Stage 5 re-emits the no-mcp bindings, so the regen and the base-identity close are RE-FIRED as `operator` entries after stage 6. This is the handoff's plan-authoring CHECK: list the operator pass's pre-push stages, regen and close as plan entries.

ONE-SHOT controls at /implement are never listed, because they mutate source and revert: Step 5's mutation checks (a)–(e). Their readings go in `evidence/mutation-checks.md`. The authored evidence records (`preregistration.md`, `acquisition.md`, `series.md`, `selection.md`, `operator-pass.md`) have no listed producer by construction: they are the written record of the legs and of the rule's application. Two listed entries read them on every re-run: the single `pick:` line, and the absence of host paths. The legs' raw `runs.json` live under the gitignored `target/l4-decision-probe/` (each leg's `artifact`), and their summaries are copied into `evidence/`.
The CI read waits 2400 s, as in the predecessor (Setup 5a read `4e5b595` still in progress at 839 s on its coverage gate); its timeout is 2580.
